name: python-z-function
title: Z-Function
blurb: The Z-array over lowercase words: the array equals the naive per-position LCP scan on seeded corpora, the concatenated occurrences equal the naive scan's starts, and z[0], the single letter, and the empty word stay honest.
default_description: A Z-array whose entries equal the naive LCP scan on any seeded word and whose occurrences equal the naive scan's starts.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: the window never hands out a letter it has not matched
